emily (IC): RCA published for the 2026-03-21 serving degradation incident: https://redwood-internal/docs/rca/1916007778-serving-deg. TL;DR: simultaneous node preemption during autoscale caused KV cache invalidations + retry storms -> model fallbacks -> p99 spike. No customer data loss; some clients saw elevated latency ~18m. Action items/checkpoints in the doc. :memo:
emily (IC): Highlights: 1) Preventive: autoscaler guardrail to disallow >30% concurrent scale-in (owner: ian, due 2026-04-07). 2) Recovery: improve fallback prioritization to deprioritize low-critical routes (owner: raj, due 2026-04-02). 3) Observability: emit retry-storm signal + dashboard (owner: maria, due 2026-04-05). 4) Post-incident test: synthetic load + preemption sim (owner: maria, due 2026-04-09). 5) Runbook update: KV cache warm-up steps (owner: ops_lead, due 2026-04-03).
emily (IC): Follow-ups: initial PR reviews by 2026-03-25, infra change canary on dedicated pool 2026-03-30, final sign-off 2026-04-10. 30m check-in Wed 10:00 PT 0 calendar invite created. @here ack or reassign by EOD tomorrow. :bell:
raj (infra): ack, I'll take fallback prioritization. Opening design doc this afternoon.
ian (runtime): ack, taking autoscaler guardrail. Q: hard reject or staged backoff? I'll propose in PR.
maria (qa): ack for dashboards + synthetic test. Need infra hour to seed preemption tests 0@raj can you allocate?
raj (infra): allocating 2h tomorrow, adding to doc.
jane (support): need customer comms? I can draft.
emily (IC): we notified affected customers; support follow-up draft would be great, use RCA template and flag escalations.
sre-bot: calendar invite "RCA follow-up: serving degradation" created for 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.
ops_lead: added KV warm-up runbook section, pushed draft, needs ops-review.
ian (runtime): prototype guardrail snippet: ```yaml
scale_in_guardrails:
  max_concurrent_scale_in_percent: 30
  grace_window_seconds: 120
```
emily (IC): once PR is up I'll run canary on dedicated pool with load profile B. Maria: run synthetic preemption test during canary window.
maria (qa): will do, posting results to RCA doc and pinging thread.
raj (infra): opened design doc: https://redwood-internal/notes/serving-fallback-prio, added reviewers @ian @ops_lead @emily.
ian (runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4288 tagging reviewers.
emily (IC): thanks, removing myself from active alerts. Monitoring stable. Reconvene at check-in, updates in doc/thread. :white_check_mark:
jane (support): drafted customer follow-up in doc, linked incident summary.
emily (IC): retrospective: add regular preemption chaos tests to CI. New initiative (ops+runtime).
maria (qa): +1, creating ticket and syncing with infra.
ops_lead: created ticket INF-1229 for scheduled preemption tests. ETA Q2 planning.
emily (IC): closing thread for now 0 ping if blockers. We'll update doc with progress. :lock:
